acceptance_predicates.description: The released ASB control backend exposes cassette catalog and strict replay through the authenticated ControlServer/ControlClient boundary.
Catalog and replay bind runner, generation, campaign, provider-profile, agent, workload, and cassette identities, rejecting stale or mismatched tuples.
Replay is digest-only and provider-egress-free, with deterministic missing-artifact reconciliation after restart.
Development exposes only typed read-only cassette catalog/replay calls; stable and mutating authorization boundaries remain fail-closed.
